stories.title: AI helping teachers focus more on students, less on administrative tasks
stories.simple_summary: Schools are using AI to handle paperwork and grading, which gives teachers more time to work with students directly.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in school, their teachers might have more time to help them. If you're involved in education, this could reduce your admin burden.

stories.title: AI looms large ahead of Xi, Trump summit
stories.simple_summary: AI is becoming an important topic in talks between the US and China's leaders.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and policy watchers — no action needed for your daily life right now.

stories.title: OpenAI Discloses Six New Incidents of ‘Concerning’ A.I. Behavior
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI disclosed six incidents where their AI system behaved in ways that concerned the company.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows companies are watching for problems, but it's primarily relevant to tech industry observers rather than everyday users.

stories.title: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it’s coming to iOS and Mac
stories.simple_summary: Snap (the company behind Snapchat) is releasing an AI helper that can connect to your other accounts and help with work tasks and travel planning.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Snapchat and want AI help organizing tasks or trips, this could be useful — but it's optional and you can ignore it if you don't want it.

stories.title: Rand Paul kills Kennedy’s AI ‘kill switch’ bill
stories.simple_summary: A US senator blocked a bill that would have created an emergency 'off switch' for AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to policy watchers and tech industry people — nothing immediate for your business or daily life.

stories.title: Research centre, AI company vandalized ahead of Montreal artificial intelligence summit
stories.simple_summary: Some people vandalized a research center and AI company offices in Montreal during an AI conference.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about protesters' concerns over AI development, but doesn't directly affect how you might use AI in your business.

stories.title: Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed safety evaluators. Will they really be independent?
stories.simple_summary: Two major AI companies want to hire independent reviewers to sit inside their labs and check if their AI systems are safe and working correctly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical governance issue mostly important to tech industry professionals — not something affecting your everyday use of AI.

stories.title: The 2.5-hour AI-generated Odyssey movie is 2.5 hours too long
stories.simple_summary: Someone made a full movie entirely with AI-generated content, and the result was poorly made and not enjoyable to watch.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI isn't yet good at creative storytelling — nothing practical you need to worry about.

stories.title: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
stories.simple_summary: AI companies are creating huge amounts of electronic waste (broken computers and equipment), and it's expected to get much worse in the coming years.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an environmental concern, but as a small business or individual, your main responsibility is to recycle your own used electronics properly.

stories.title: Florida sets new rules for how students, teachers can use AI. Here’s what to know
stories.simple_summary: Florida schools created rules about when and how students and teachers can use AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Florida with school-age family members, the schools will have clearer policies on AI use — you may want to ask your school what those rules are.

stories.title: After accusations of selling ‘perv glasses,’ Meta prepares to sell a pair without a camera
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) faced criticism over glasses with cameras, so they're making a version without a camera.
stories.why_it_matters: If you were worried about privacy with smart glasses, camera-free versions may become available — but this is optional technology you'd choose to use.

stories.title: Trump adviser Sacks says AI fears driven by 'fear-mongering playbook'
stories.simple_summary: A Trump adviser said worries about AI dangers are being exaggerated to scare people.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political opinion-making — experts genuinely disagree on AI risks, so this is just one perspective among many.
